correctness.rationale: The proof begins with Torres's exact bipartite k-matching halfspace description; rigorously computes orthogonal projected edge and star norms in both affine-hull regimes; derives sharp bounds by summing inequalities; and constructs the uniform optimizer. Equality plus strict slack yields all centers and dimensions. Sparse K4-incidence example has \\(1/\\sqrt{12}\\), dimension three; K5 incidence has \\(1/\\sqrt{12}\\), unique center. Independently formulated numerical LP code passed 132 cases. Numerical checks do not replace the proof.
